description: Defines the HostResolverSystemTask class and related functions for asynchronous system DNS resolution with retries, overrides, and callback mechanisms within the net namespace.

classes.name: HostResolverSystemTask
classes.description: Manages asynchronous host resolution with retries, overrides, and callback handling.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a HostResolverSystemTask for a specific hostname and parameters.

methods.name: CreateForOwnHostname
methods.description: Creates a HostResolverSystemTask to resolve the local machine's hostname.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins the resolution process, invoking the callback upon completion.

methods.name: was_completed
methods.description: Checks if the resolution has been completed.
